divergences.en_says: Abortion is the termination of a pregnancy by removal or expulsion of an embryo or fetus. The unmodified word abortion generally refers to induced abortion... Abortion occurring without intervention is known as spontaneous abortion or "miscarriage"
divergences.other_says: Ein Schwangerschaftsabbruch... ist die vorzeitige Beendigung einer Schwangerschaft, die das Ungeborene gewolltermaßen nicht überlebt. Davon zu unterscheiden ist der übergeordnete medizinische Begriff Abort; dieser umfasst auch einen natürlichen Spontanabort... Ein Kaiserschnitt fällt ebenso wenig unter die vorgenannten Begriffe wie die Einleitung der Geburt eines lebensfähigen Kindes.
divergences.evidence_en: Abortion occurring without intervention is known as spontaneous abortion or "miscarriage"

divergences.en_says: Common reasons for inducing an abortion are birth-timing and limiting family size. Other reasons include maternal health, an inability to afford a child, domestic violence, lack of support, feelings of being too young, wishing to complete an education or advance a career, and not being able, or willing, to raise a child conceived as a result of rape or incest.

Around 73 million abortions are performed each year in the world, with about 45% done unsafely... As of 2018, 37% of the world's women had access to legal abortions without limits as to reason. Abortion rates are similar between countries that restrict abortion and countries that broadly allow it

summary: EN and FA leads are nearly identical in structure, statistics, reasons, and framing. DE diverges by providing distinct German medical terminology distinctions, Germany-specific safety statements, explicit historical examples of legalization and recent restrictions (Poland, US states), and omits global statistics and the enumerated list of reasons for abortion.
